MajorDuties: Duty 1: Performs maintenance/installation on base owned communications cable, installations of OSP and ISP cable/wiring systems; monitors government Quality Assurance Personnel (QAP) contractor performance and quality of installed communications systems to include fiber optics, copper core cable, voice and data premise wiring and modifications of maintenance work upon the various cable circuits and associated systems. Duty 2: Develop designs for circuit configurations, testing, implementation, circuit integration, maintenance, quality assurance, and the administration of network systems for LAN, WAN, and MAN, Voice Over Internet Protocol (VOJP), Internet/Intranet systems and premise wiring in support of voice and data requirements. Duty 3: Perform engineering, planning, analysis, design, development, and implementation for copper and fiber optic cable systems. Duty 4: Maintains assigned vehicles, tools, and job related safety practices in a safe manner. Duty 5:Performs quality assurance evaluations and inspections, performs project reviews, uses verbal/written communications skills to provide updates, suggest improvements, and prepare/conduct training.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.OrganizationName: Commander, Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWARSYSCOM)
MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: In addition to the four competencies listed below, your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Demonstrated knowledge of C4ISR (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and Commercial Off-The-Shelf hardware and software installation and modernization processes; Demonstrated competency and ability to understand and effectively communicate the technical and programmatic aspects of those projects under the cognizance of the C4I Integration Branch. Your experience must reflect skill in the following areas: attention to detail, customer service, oral communication, and problem solving. 1. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: conduct test events for these systems specifically with test planning, test setup, test execution, test analysis and documentation which includes test objective, test plan, and test report development. 2. Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services. IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: will work in various collaborative lab environments with other team members and follow the security policies and procedures, periodic reviews of LAB Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)s, COMSEC management guidelines, complete security training and meet all safety requirements. 3. Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: required to brief technical and programmatic at the Division, Dept., Center or Sponsor/Stakeholder level. 4. Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: assist in solving problems in hardware-software interfaces.In addition to my experience demonstrating the four competencies above, I have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-12) or pay band in the federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector: Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/ Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment Position has been designated as a Cyber IT/cybersecurity Workforce position in specialty area 802 as a condition of employment incumbents of this position are required to comply with the DON Cyber IT/CSWF program requirements of SECNAVM-5239.2 which include: Earn and maintain appropriate credentials from the Cyber IT/CSWF Qualification Matrix (described in SECNAV M-5239.2) associated with the specialty area and level commensurate with the scope of major assigned duties for the position to which you are assigned, and; Per SECNAVINST 1543.2, Cyber It/CSWF individuals shall participate annually in 40 hours of continuous learning (CL) activities to be documented in a current individual development plan (IDP) signed by both the employee and supervisor.

Details.JobSummary: You will serve as an IT SPECIALIST (NETWORK) in the SPAWAR SYSTEMS COMMAND of NAVWARSYSCEN PACIFIC SAN DIEGO CA. Initial consideration for this announcement is limited to the number of applications listed at the top of this announcement. All applications received on the day the application limit is reached will be accepted and processed. This is a RE-ADVERTISEMENT of Announcement Number: ST-11760789-23-EM. Applicants that have previously applied NEED to re-apply to this announcement.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite! This position is in the Science & Technology Reinvention Laboratory (STRL) Human Resource Management System pay band for Department of Defense laboratories.
MajorDuties: You will project management expertise and installation execution services supporting the delivery and integration of new/modernized Command, Control, Communications Computer, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities.
You will have immediate responsibility for long and short-range planning, systems survey and design, on-site engineering, and installation of various C4ISR systems.

You will demonstrate detailed knowledge of network architectures and components, including data communication and transmission , input/output devices, control processor units, data processors, Communication Security, and Satellite Communication.
You will oversee all hardware/software installations, including the initial configuration of the equipment/system.
You will provide specialized system engineering in support of various developmental data communications and graphic display systems at various command centers and shore facilities.
You will develop and report compliance with required Project Management Plans (PMP) that address scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality assurance, and material procurement/contract management.
Details.Education: This position has no education substitute for specialized experience.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GG-11 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: providing telecommunications support inside plant, outside plant, and DSN telephone services and Circuit Actions. Perform Contract Officer Representative functions for contractor personnel and any telecommunications contracts. Develop POM submissions and all telecommunication related function integrity. Examples of Qualifying Experience: Serve as a Telecommunications Manager (BASE COMM OFF) in the U.S. NAVAL COMPUTER AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS STATION of NAVCOMTELSTA FAR EAST YOKOSUKA. Provide guidance and oversight to the U.S. Naval Computer and Telecommunications Station (NCTS) Far East regional BCO as the Yokosuka BCO Manager. Manages the administrative, accounting, maintenance, engineering, contracting and contract management and switch management functions within the Yokosuka Base Communications Office. Details.JobSummary: You will serve as a TELECOMMUNICATIONS MANAGER in the Network Infrastructure Department (NI) of US NAVAL COM & TELCOM STA FAR EAST. This position is a DoD Cyber Excepted Service (CES) personnel system position in the Excepted Service under 10 U.S.C. 1599f.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The Navy and Marine Corps team offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. Department of the Navy provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. From pipefitters to accountants, scientists to engineers, doctors to nurses-the careers and opportunities to make a difference are endless. Civilian careers-where purpose and patriotism unite!
MajorDuties: You will begin all responsibility statements with 'You will'; each field should have no more than one sentence; list the responsibilities in a logical order; and avoid using federal or military jargon. 250 Characters.
You will promote and further the Equal Opportunity program.
You will determine division data processing requirements necessary to support telecommunications workflow and records management.
You will evaluate methods of providing automation and develop plans and procedures to meet division data processing requirements.
You will coordinate installation and upgrades of systems with US and host nation government and contractor technical personnel.
You will set long-range priorities and schedules for division staff.
You will assist customers in defining their basic and contingency communications needs in conjunction with DSN program implementation.
You will advise on the interpretation and application of policies, standards and procedures for evaluation of current and future communications needs.
You will coordinate with users concerning modification of requirements to minimize or eliminate technical problems or excessive costs.
You will serve as liaison between technical personnel developing detailed plans and procedures, and activities experiencing problems and/or delays in using services.
You will represent the Base Communications Office at meetings, conferences, and workshops with counterparts from other military services, federal agencies, and industry.
You will resolve questionable aspects of proposals with originating offices and other technical and support personnel.
You will review proposed communications elements of projects for completeness, mission supportability and justification of requirements.
You will coordinate actions required for carrying out communications projects.
You will conduct customer surveys and interviews to identify problems and needs with respect to the DSN program.
You will direct the development and implementation of a DSN customer education program.

Business Based Action Family Member Preference Military Spouse Preference Outside Applicant Veteran Spouse/Widow/Parent of Veteran Transition Hiring Preference In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below. Details.JobSummary: About the position: This position is located at the Resource Management, Yokota AB, Japan. This is Regular Full-Time position, guaranteed 40 hours a week.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: The 374 Force Support Squadron is a team of 1,000+ military, civilians and local nationals. We work together to provide enhanced quality of life for the 12,000 Yokota Air Base community members and over 150,000 transient personnel that visit Yokota every year via facilities and programs centered on morale, welfare, recreation and total force development. Our operations are the fourth largest in the Air Force: 13 dining facilities; personnel readiness and accountability; lodging; fitness; recreation; resiliency; child and youth programs; community building; mortuary affairs; NEO; Professional Development; and Education and Training. The squadron is comprised of eight flights, 49 activities and 159 facilities. Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF).
MajorDuties: Provides technical support to the 374th Force Support Squadron to ensure proper functional use of IT equipment and programs and to preclude undue interruptions to IT services. Work involves the management of the IT system administration, IT network services and security, which includes +200 software systems and + 10 commercial systems loaded on +800 computer units, for +400 users, in over 43 locations on and off Yokota AB. Responsibilities include planning, designing, coordinating, purchasing, installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting hardware and software systems; and implementing new updates, repairs, and additions to commercial IT systems, including networks, in order to meet AF requirements and standards. Helps to ensure business systems are up to date and configured/optimized in accordance with current AF requirements and initiatives. Aids in developing, planning, and executing IT projects. Assists in building, installing, configuring, optimizing, and managing networks and network components; network monitoring; and diagnosing and resolving network problems. Installs cable and connects LAN/W AN/WIFI computer workstations to support W AN/LAN/WIFI environments. Installs and maintains hardware, software, and network devices for all computer users. Resolves interface and interoperability problems. Maintains inter-connectivity between 374 FSS's specialized and non-specialized systems, and other local and remote systems. Establishes TCP/IP and DHCP connectivity with other systems and base and remote e-mail. Provides technical training and assistance to users to assist the user in effectively using the systems. Serves as a consultant for all computer users. Ensures all equipment is maintained pursuant to DoD and USAF requirements. Coordinates with other base/DOD agencies as well as contractors to ensure compliance standards are met, and serves as liaison between users and commercial technical support. Manages supplies to support office and common-use peripheral equipment. Performs scheduled backups and equipment inventories. Collects management information data on system operation. Works under the direct supervision of the IT System supervisor, who defines the employee's scope of work responsibilities, objectives, priorities, and deadlines. Ensures the thorough application of information security & information assurance policies, principles, and practices. Implements security plans, procedures, and training to comply with Wing, Air Force, and Department of Defense standards. Conducts Client System Administrator (CSA) training for functional area. Monitors CSA notices and initiates directed actions as appropriate. Performs other related duties as assigned. Position is a position of trust. If interested in this position please preview the online application: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/11806106
